{{Top|leg}}
'''Burrowers''' were a number of related, [[Diet/Legends|omnivorous]], [[Rodent/Legends|rodent]]-like [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Yavin 8/Legends|Yavin 8]].

The term was also used for small, fossorial [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]] from [[Elom/Legends|Elom]], preyed upon by [[cherfer]]s.
